title: chip-chop AI settings
description: Which AI CLI runs each stage, with which model and arguments. Stored per project at <app>/.chipchop/ai.yaml, or globally at ~/.chipchop/ai.yaml. Project settings override global ones.

providers.description: Named providers. The names are free; stages refer to them.

stages.description: One entry per stage, so each can use a different provider and model (a small model for flows, a stronger one for mocks).

maxRepairs.description: How many times validation errors are sent back to the AI to fix.

promptsDir.description: Folder with prompt templates that replace the built-in ones: discover.md, flows.md, mocks.md, repair.md.

type.description: claude: Claude Code CLI. copilot: GitHub Copilot CLI. custom: any CLI, described with args.

command.description: Executable name or absolute path. Defaults to claude / copilot.

allowedTools.description: claude only. Tools allowed without prompting. Default: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit.

allowTools.description: copilot only. Passed to --allow-tool. Default: write.

denyTools.description: copilot only. Passed to --deny-tool. Default: shell.

args.description: custom only. Full argument list. {prompt} and {model} are replaced; an argument pair is dropped when {model} is empty.

promptVia.description: custom only. How the prompt is delivered. Default: arg.

provider.description: Key of an entry in providers.

model.description: Free text, passed to the CLI as is (an alias or a full model name).
